caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chair positioned at a slight angle, showing both its front and the right side. The chair features a curved, slightly contoured seat and a high, slightly curved backrest composed of slender vertical spindles. The top rail of the backrest is broad and gently arched upward at the ends. There are five turned legs, each with decorative detailing, and additional horizontal and diagonal support struts connecting the legs for stability. The entire chair is rendered in various shades of light and medium brown, emphasizing the wood grain and contours. The background is a plain, light beige color, and there is a faint rectangular border around the drawing. The name “Eugene Croe” is written in the bottom right corner.
title: Windsor Chair
